$comment: Single source of truth for the IDEAS Logo. Edit here, then run `npm run build`. Letter grids: '#' = Voxel, 'o' = Hollow Voxel, '.' = empty. Option A letterforms from the www-ideas prototype, refined and approved by the IDEAS lead in #3: one hand-placed Hollow Voxel per letter on a stroke end, 5x22 grid. Tests pin the Hollow Voxel positions, so moving one is a deliberate change to the test too.

icon.$comment: The Icon: a single voxel "i", for favicons, avatars and slide corners. Same cell grammar as the Wordmark letters; the tittle is the hand-placed Hollow Voxel, the base bar keeps the mark sturdy at 16px.

tagline.$comment: Always lowercase inside the Logo. Each entry is one line of the three-line Tagline, as the www-ideas prototype header wraps it; outlined from the font file at build time, so no output depends on an installed font.
